# Commonwealth Fund Interactives

> > Interactive data visualizations and research tools exploring U.S. health system performance, state health rankings, Medicare/Medicaid history, and healthcare policy analysis.

The Commonwealth Fund's interactive platform provides comprehensive scorecards comparing state health system performance, historical timelines of major healthcare programs like Medicare and Medicaid, and regional health system profiles. These tools support evidence-based healthcare policy research and track disparities in healthcare access, quality, and outcomes across states and communities.

## Key Topics

- State Health System Performance Rankings
- Medicare and Medicaid Programs
- Healthcare Access and Disparities
- Medicaid Expansion
- Healthcare Quality Metrics
- Social Security Act and Amendments
- Healthcare Policy and Legislation
- State-by-State Health Comparisons
- Regional Health System Analysis
- Healthcare Performance Indicators
- The Commonwealth Fund Research
- Medicare Part A and Part B
- 50-Year Medicare History
- District of Columbia Health Data

## State Health System Scorecards

- [2018 Scorecard on State Health System Performance](https://interactives.commonwealthfund.org/2018/state-scorecard/): Comprehensive 2018 state health system rankings evaluating healthcare access, quality, outcomes, and disparities across all 50 states and DC
- [2018 Scorecard Highlights](https://interactives.commonwealthfund.org/2018/state-scorecard/highlights/): Key findings and highlights from the 2018 state health scorecard showing top performers and areas for improvement
- [Nevada State Health Performance](https://interactives.commonwealthfund.org/2018/state-scorecard/state/nevada/): Detailed health system performance metrics, rankings, and analysis for Nevada

## Medicare and Healthcare History

- [50 Years of Medicare Timeline](https://interactives.commonwealthfund.org/medicare-timeline/): Interactive timeline chronicling Medicare's evolution from FDR through 50 years of program development, legislation, and policy changes

## Regional Health System Profiles

- [Buffalo and Western New York](https://interactives.commonwealthfund.org/all-health-care-is-local/buffalo.html): Local health system analysis for the Buffalo and Western New York region including performance metrics and community health data
